full_text:
Article 3 (Establishment and Composition of Subcommittees)
(1) Subcommittees established under Article 8 (1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as "subcommittees") shall be classified and established as the Agricultural Subcommittee, Fisheries Subcommittee, Forestry Subcommittee, Rural Communities Subcommittee, and Agricultural and Fisheries Food Subcommittee. <Amended on June 2, 2025>
(2) Each subcommittee shall consist of no more than 20 members, including one chairperson of the subcommittee (hereinafter referred to as a "subcommittee chairperson").
